subject: Privacy & cross-border controls — DPA annex and transfer playbook (Novagen)
messages:
From: Elena Smith <elena.smith@novagen.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novagen.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: DPA annex + cross-border controls (Novagen onboarding)

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo earlier this week — Novagen liked the latency profiles and the price math. Procurement & legal asked me to gather Redwood's product-level answers for cross-border transfers so we can complete our vendor RFP. At a minimum they want:

- The DPA annex (processor terms) you would expect Novagen to sign
- Controls / evidence for cross-border transfers (EU/US as example) — what mechanisms do you rely on (DPF, SCCs, BCRs, other) and operational evidence we can attach to our procurement file
- Data residency / routing options and whether we can pin traffic to a US-only region for production workloads
- Key management and access controls for customer data (KMS/HSM integrations, customer-managed keys)
- Retention/erasure controls and audit log availability for compliance windows

Can you share a package we can send to our legal team (PDF preferred) plus a short walkthrough call next week? We have a target procurement completion date of 2027-06-04.

Appreciate it — Elena

Elena Smith | Vendor Enablement
Novagen Therapeutics
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Smith <elena.smith@novagen.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: DPA annex + cross-border controls (Novagen onboarding)

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Attaching an initial DPA annex draft (redwood-dpa-annex_v1.pdf) and a short cross-border evidence worksheet that summarizes controls and transfer mechanisms. Highlights up front:

- Transfer mechanisms: Redwood supports SCCs (adopted and recommended), EU-US transfer via an internally maintained DPF mapping (we can provide the DPF summary), and per-customer routing to EU/US regions for production.
- Operational controls: KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP Cloud KMS, optional customer-managed keys), HSM-backed keywrap for dedupe artifacts, layered role-based access, and immutable audit logs (retainable via Console exports).
- Residency options: For Dedicated/Private customers we can ensure compute and KV caches remain in a pinned region; hosted customers can opt for region routing with SLA constraints.
- Evidence: the attached worksheet lists the typical artifacts we provide for procurement (architecture diagram, dataflow mapping, audit log retention description, test export logs).

Next steps: 1) I've looped in Ben (sales lead) and Kimberly (legal) to surface any known redlines; 2) propose a 30-min technical + legal walkthrough on Wed 19 May 09:00-09:30 PT — does that work for you?

I'll also surface the DPF summary + control matrix in the Drive link below.

Drive: https://drive.redwoodinference.com/s/novagen-dpa-pack

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Sales, West Coast
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-dpa-annex_v1.pdf, crossborder-evidence-worksheet.xlsx
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Smith <elena.smith@novagen.com>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: DPA annex + cross-border controls (Novagen onboarding)

Vanessa / Ben — quick read and a few internal notes + an attached redline (redwood-dpa-annex_v2_redlines.pdf). I pulled the items Novagen is likely to press on and added negotiation guidance:

- Article on subprocessors: we should be explicit about subprocessor lists and commit to notice + 30-day removal window where technically feasible.
- Transfer mechanism language: prefer to offer SCCs as primary with the DPF mapping as supplemental operational evidence (keeps contract language standard).
- KMS / customer-managed keys: include optional clause for CMK with documented provisioning steps; flag for SOC engagement if customer requests dedicated HSM.
- Logging & retention: include explicit access to audit exports for 90/180/365-day windows depending on tier (hosted vs. dedicated).
- SLA & fallbacks: recommend adding a brief operational fallback clause (model variant fallback / cross-region failover) so Novagen sees reliability mitigations.

Ben — please confirm the proposed Wed 19 May slot for the joint call and whether Sales will accept a 60-day signature window for the standard annex. I suggest we bring a short slide (1–2) to the walkthrough summarizing the DPF mapping and evidence artifacts.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Data Protection
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-dpa-annex_v2_redlines.pdf
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@novagen.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Privacy & cross-border controls — DPA annex and transfer playbook (Novagen)

Thanks all — the package looks good and the redlines are helpful. Wed 19 May 09:00 PT works for us for the walkthrough (Elena and I will join). A couple of clarifications before the call so our legal team can prep:

- For SCCs: can you confirm whether your implementation will be the standard 2021 SCCs and whether you sign as processor with those clauses intact?
- For DPF: please bring a one-page mapping showing which data categories flow to which jurisdictions and the fallback routing rules when a region is saturated.
- For CMK: Novagen is interested in CMK for production chat logs — please bring the provisioning checklist and any cost delta for CMK support.

We will review the redline PDF and come prepared with the top 3 changes we expect to propose. If all looks good after the walkthrough we can move to DocuSign; I will aim to have procurement sign-off by 2027-06-04.

DocuSign request (if helpful): https://na1.docusign.net/novagen/NG-2027-052/request

Appreciate the quick turn,
Daniel Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
Novagen Therapeutics
